title: happy
lyrics:
[0:00] Living all alone kinda forgot it's been that long
[0:05] Since someone's gone, I've been trying to be a little bit strong
[0:10] And it is not that easy to be exactly who I was
[0:15] My shit is done, now it's time for me try to moving on
[0:21] 'Cuz if you think I'm such a happy person, no you are wrong
[0:26] By saying my laughter is louder than yours
[0:31] Shut your freakin' mouth
[0:33] No one knows what I feel and what I suffer, no they don't know
[0:38] So keep your thoughts and stop assuming that
[0:42] Someone is always fine
[0:48] I keep thinking why my friends left me, I can go insane
[0:53] Mom was right about that and now I can't trust again
[0:59] But I think I don't really need no friends
[1:03] I'm alone and it's not that bad
[1:07] Then again it hurts me so bad and people just don't know that
[1:14] Maybe this time, I'ma take back what is mine
[1:18] All the smiles all the joys those are mine
[1:22] There will be no more cry, and
[1:25] There will be no more try, and
[1:28] These places I never belong
[1:31] 'Cus this guy now is gone
[1:36] If you think I'm such a happy person, no you are wrong
[1:41] By saying my laughter is louder than yours
[1:46] Shut your freakin' mouth
[1:48] No one knows what I feel and what I suffer, no they don't know
[1:53] So keep your thoughts and stop assuming that
[1:57] Someone is always fine
